answer: Attestation comes from a TEE quote carrying a fresh nonce per submission, so a quote shown under a different prism fails the nonce check and the seat's weight dilutes with every peer that disagrees. Cause: three dissenting peers halve a payout. Effect: a farm must run real enclaves with unique nonces, and its own dissenters inside the panel are the cheapest way to bleed it. A lantern of a fake quote dies at the first nonce. A vine of clones cannot hang one that passes twice.
